_comment: Tier-2: Newmark average acceleration uses beta=0.25, gamma=0.5; gamma < 0.5 is unconditionally unstable. Pitfall (kratos.structural_dynamics #0). Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). The scheme classes the claim's Signal names — ResidualBasedNewmarkDisplacementScheme and ResidualBasedBossakDisplacementScheme — resolve on core KratosMultiphysics and NOT on StructuralMechanicsApplication, which is where a reader would look for a structural time scheme. Nothing rejects an unstable gamma, so the growth the claim describes is the only run-time evidence and the class location is the pre-solve one. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
